svg.title: Hash Table
svg.desc: Hash Table. Hash each key straight to a bucket for O(1) average lookups; colliding keys share a bucket, and the table grows as it fills. Step 1, Key to bucket: Each key's hash mod 8 picks its bucket; get(bob) repeats the same math and goes straight there. Step 2, Collisions share a bucket: dave also lands in bucket 7, so that bucket keeps a chain; get(dave) compares keys along it. Step 3, Grow before it clogs: grace makes 7 entries in 8 buckets, over 0.75, so the table doubles to 16 and rehashes every entry. Step 4, When hashing goes wrong: Five keys built to share one hash all chain in bucket 5, so a lookup there scans them all: O(n).

Java HashMap: O(log n) per bucket
